suspect key: Jinnah did not attend 3rd RTC; Ambedkar/Sapru attended all three

patterns: Direct year/number items dominate: year of 1st RTC (1930), RTC held in 1932 (3rd), session of Fourteen Points (1929).
Favourite trap: which RTC the Congress attended (only 2nd, Gandhi sole representative); who attended all three (Ambedkar, Sapru).
Nehru Report asked as 'prepared by' (Motilal) and as the cause of the Independence for India League; Butler Committee and Deepavali Declaration asked as object/content one-liners.
APPSC tilt: Simon boycott in Andhra (Prakasam, Parthasarathi firing) and match-the-RTC items; app covers these well.
App MCQs lean on multi-statement formats; PYQs are mostly single-fact, plus trivia like Gandhi's ship (S.S. Rajputana) and stay (Kingsley Hall) that app does not cover.
